title: Optimized multilevel Monte Carlo methods in Banach spaces
summary: We present a theoretical and numerical analysis of Monte Carlo methods for the estimation of statistical moments of random variables $X:Ω\rightarrow E$ taking values in a Banach space $E$. For practical computation, we consider finite-dimensional approximation subspaces ${(E_\ell)_{\ell\in\mathbb{N}}\subset E}$ of increasing dimension.
